text.en: Ravi rubbed a plastic comb on his hair and it picked up tiny paper bits. "Electric charge!" said his teacher.

Matter contains positive and negative charges. An atom that gains extra electrons becomes a negative ion. The charge of one electron, 1.6 x 10^-19 coulomb, is the fundamental unit of charge, and the total charge of a system is the algebraic sum of all its charges. Like charges repel and unlike charges attract, and this force is the electric force.
Electric current is the rate at which charge flows past a point in a circuit. By convention it is taken as the flow of positive charge, called conventional current. A cell or battery supplies the electromotive force (emf), which is the work done in driving a unit charge around the complete circuit. Potential difference is V = W / q.
Resistance is the opposition a component offers to the flow of current. One ohm is the resistance when a potential difference of one volt drives one ampere. Good conductors have low resistance and resistors are components made to provide resistance. Electric current has heating, magnetic and chemical effects, and electricity can be dangerous if it is handled carelessly.

problem.en: A charge of 10 C flows through a lamp in 5 s. Find the current.

prompt.en: A friend says Current flows only in metals as electrons. How will you reply?
